messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up — PR #9247 is ready but blocked on architecture signoff. RFC linked below. Can the arch team take a look? CI is green but this changes routing/fallback behavior so we want explicit design ack before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/9247 RFC: https://r.redwood.dev/rfcs/457

deploy-bot: CI: ✅ all checks passed (unit, integration, e2e). Deploy preview available at https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/9247 · rerun with `/ci rerun`

leah: Thanks for the ping. Two quick asks: 1) add a short SLO impact summary in the PR description, 2) point me to the exact RFC section that justifies the region-fallback decision. I can do an async review tonight. :eyes:

jordan: Done — added SLO bullets under "risks/impact" and linked RFC section 3.2 in the PR description. TL;DR: introduces tiered region-fallback routing (primary -> secondary -> economy) with preserved KV cache semantics, estimated 4% p95 latency delta under failover.

eric: I can review but would like a quick 15m sync with infra to confirm capacity and quota impacts. If folks prefer async, I can comment inline tomorrow AM. Ping me with times.

sasha: did a fast pass, left 2 comments about metric tags and a nit on variable names. Not blocking. :thumbsup:

leah: If the infra sync is optional, I can give an async LGTM tonight if the infra questions are answered in-thread. Otherwise schedule the 15m and I’ll join.

jordan: I updated the PR with answers to the infra questions (quota/scheduling note + fallback TTL). Also added a short remediation playbook in the doc. Example local canary command in PR:```
# run canary locally
./scripts/run_canary.sh --config configs/fallback-canary.json
```

oncall: FYI from ops — if this goes to canary expect a small burst of job creation; we have a short window (10m) to rollback before autoscaling stabilizes.

jordan: Great — marking the PR status as: BLOCKED -> awaiting arch LGTM. If no async LGTMs by 09:00 PST tomorrow I’ll schedule the 15m infra check. Thanks all! :v:
